name: Sound Sensor Module
fullName: High-Sensitivity Microphone Sound Level Detection Module (LM393)
tagline: Acoustic sensor with analog amplitude output and digital sound threshold trigger
description: The Sound Sensor module uses an electret condenser microphone paired with an LM393 comparator and internal audio preamplifier. It outputs both a continuous analog voltage proportional to sound volume (AO) and a digital high/low trigger (DO) when volume exceeds the potentiometer threshold.

specs.microphoneType: Electret Condenser Microphone (50 Hz to 20 kHz)
specs.outputs: Dual Output: Analog (AO raw signal) and Digital (DO threshold pulse)
specs.sensitivity: Adjustable via onboard multiturn precision potentiometer

pinout.name: Digital Out
pinout.desc: Active-LOW / HIGH pulse when sound exceeds threshold

wiringNote: For measuring continuous decibel noise levels, read the AO pin via analogRead() and compute peak-to-peak amplitude over a 50ms sampling window.
commonMistakes: Reading only single analogRead() points without window sampling (audio is an AC sine wave centered at ~2.5V)
Using digital output DO expecting precise decibel values
